'''Harju Jalgpallikool Laagri''', commonly known as '''Harju JK''', or simply as '''Harju''', is an [[Estonia]]n professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Laagri]], [[Harjumaa]]. Founded in 2009, the club competes in the [[Meistriliiga]], the top flight of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]].

Harju entered senior football in 2015, debuted in Meistriliiga in 2023 and competes in the top flight again since 2025."}}
